GlowingVoiceAttempts1Line2.Text:
YOUR WILL...
YOUR RESOLVE TO CHANGE FATE...
I COULD FEEL IT SHINING.

GlowingVoiceAttempts1Line3.Text:
AND YET...
IT BRINGS YOU
ONLY ONE
CHOICE.

GlowingVoiceAttempts2Line1.Text: AND SO, YOU MEET WITH THE SAME FATE.

GlowingVoiceWinLine1.Text:
WONDERFUL...
THROUGH OUR CONNECTION, DELTARUNE GLOWS
EVER BRIGHTER.

GlowingVoiceWinLine2.Text:
NOW... THERE IS ONLY ONE.

THE LAST STORY.

GlowingVoiceWinLine4.Text:
WE WILL MEET THERE...
WON'T WE?
